mapper.select: SELECT * FROM staff WHERE position_id IS NULL
SELECT s.* FROM staff s LEFT JOIN position p ON s.position_id = p.id WHERE p.authority LIKE 'Farm%' OR p.authority LIKE 'Restaurant%'
SELECT MAX(CAST(username AS SIGNED)) FROM staff
SELECT s.* FROM staff s LEFT JOIN position p ON s.position_id = p.id WHERE p.authority = 'FarmStaff'
SELECT s.* FROM staff s LEFT JOIN position p ON s.position_id = p.id WHERE p.authority = 'RestaurantStaff'
SELECT * FROM staff WHERE position_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT s.* FROM staff s LEFT JOIN position p ON s.position_id = p.id WHERE p.authority IN ('FarmManager', 'RestaurantManager')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO staff (username, password, name, tel_number, email, address, id_card_no, position_id) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{telNumber}, #{email}, #{address}, #{idCardNo}, #{position.id})
